[← Back to home](index.html){style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:0.8em;color:#555;text-decoration:none;padding:4px 10px;border:0.5px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif"}

Adjust θ, asymmetry $s$, categories $K$, and discrimination $a$ to see how threshold spacing shapes the mismatch between a GPCM item and two binomial approximations:

- the **mean-matched binomial** (the oracle of the manuscript's KL decomposition), with $f(\theta) = \mathrm{E}[X\mid\theta]/(K-1)$ taken from the true GPCM, which reproduces the GPCM's ERF exactly; and
- the **Binom 2PL**, the best-fitting logistic binomial $f(\theta) = \mathrm{logistic}(a'(\theta-b'))$, chosen to minimize expected KL divergence from the GPCM over $\theta \sim N(0,1)$.

The binomial's KL divergence from the GPCM splits exactly into a **structural** term, the loss of the mean-matched binomial, which no link function can remove, and a **link** term, $(K-1)\,\mathrm{KL}\{\mathrm{Bern}(f^*)\Vert\mathrm{Bern}(f)\}$, the extra loss from getting the mean wrong. The decomposition panel below computes both, at the chosen θ and averaged over $\theta \sim N(0,1)$, using the same grid and fitting criterion as the manuscript's Table of the decomposition (`kl_decomposition.R`), for a single item with no threshold noise.

```{ojs}
viewof theta = Inputs.range([-3, 3], {label: "θ (ability)", step: 0.05, value: 0.5})
viewof asym  = Inputs.range([-2.1, 2.1], {label: "s (asymmetry)", step: 0.05, value: 2.1})
viewof K     = Inputs.range([3, 7], {label: "K (categories)", step: 1, value: 5})
viewof a     = Inputs.range([0.5, 2.5], {label: "a (discrimination)", step: 0.05, value: 1.5})
viewof comp  = Inputs.radio(["Mean-matched binomial", "Binom 2PL"], {label: "Binomial in CRF and bar plots", value: "Mean-matched binomial"})
```

```{ojs}
function makeThresholds(K, asym) {
  const n = K - 1, range = 3.0;
  if (Math.abs(asym) < 1e-9 || n <= 2)
    return Array.from({length: n}, (_, i) => -range/2 + i * range / (n - 1));
  const weights = Array.from({length: n - 1}, (_, i) => Math.exp(asym * i / (n - 2)));
  const ws = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const gaps = weights.map(w => w / ws * range);
  const b = [-range / 2];
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) b.push(b[b.length - 1] + gaps[i]);
  b.push(b[n - 2] + gaps[n - 2]);
  return b;
}

function gpcmPr(theta, a, b) {
  const Kl = b.length + 1;
  const ln = new Array(Kl).fill(0);
  for (let k = 1; k < Kl; k++) ln[k] = ln[k-1] + a * (theta - b[k-1]);
  const mx = Math.max(...ln);
  const ex = ln.map(v => Math.exp(v - mx));
  const sm = ex.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  return ex.map(v => v / sm);
}

function dbinom(k, n, p) {
  if (p <= 0) return k === 0 ? 1 : 0;
  if (p >= 1) return k === n ? 1 : 0;
  let lc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) lc += Math.log(n - i) - Math.log(i + 1);
  return Math.exp(lc + k * Math.log(p) + (n - k) * Math.log(1 - p));
}
binomVec = (n, p) => Array.from({length: n + 1}, (_, k) => dbinom(k, n, p))
meanOf = p => p.reduce((s, v, k) => s + k * v, 0)
clamp = (x, lo, hi) => Math.min(Math.max(x, lo), hi)
logistic = x => 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-x))
klVec = (P, Q) => P.reduce((s, p, k) => p > 0 ? s + p * (Math.log(p) - Math.log(Math.max(Q[k], 1e-300))) : s, 0)
bernKL = (m, f) => m * Math.log(m / f) + (1 - m) * Math.log((1 - m) / (1 - f))

// Mean-matched (oracle) binomial: f*(θ) = E[X|θ]/(K−1) from the true GPCM
fStar = (th) => clamp(meanOf(gpcmPr(th, a, thresholds)) / (K - 1), 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)
// Best-fitting Binom 2PL
f2PL = (th) => clamp(logistic(fit2PL.a2 * (th - fit2PL.b2)), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)

thetaGrid = Array.from({length: 121}, (_, i) => -3 + i * 0.05)
thresholds = makeThresholds(K, asym)

// Population grid and weights, as in kl_decomposition.R: θ in [−6, 6], 1201 points, N(0,1) weights
popGrid = Array.from({length: 1201}, (_, i) => -6 + i * 0.01)
popW = { const w = popGrid.map(t => Math.exp(-t * t / 2)); const s = w.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0); return w.map(v => v / s); }

function nelderMead(f, x0, scale, maxIt) {
  const n = x0.length; let S = [x0.slice()];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = x0.slice(); x[i] += scale; S.push(x); }
  let F = S.map(f);
  for (let it = 0; it < maxIt; it++) {
    const ord = F.map((v, i) => i).sort((i, j) => F[i] - F[j]); S = ord.map(i => S[i]); F = ord.map(i => F[i]);
    if (Math.abs(F[n] - F[0]) < 1e-15) break;
    const c = Array(n).fill(0); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) for (let d = 0; d < n; d++) c[d] += S[i][d] / n;
    const pt = t => c.map((v, d) => v + t * (S[n][d] - v));
    const xr = pt(-1), fr = f(xr);
    if (fr < F[0]) { const xe = pt(-2), fe = f(xe); if (fe < fr) { S[n] = xe; F[n] = fe; } else { S[n] = xr; F[n] = fr; } }
    else if (fr < F[n - 1]) { S[n] = xr; F[n] = fr; }
    else {
      const xc = fr < F[n] ? pt(-0.5) : pt(0.5), fc = f(xc);
      if (fc < Math.min(fr, F[n])) { S[n] = xc; F[n] = fc; }
      else { for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { S[i] = S[i].map((v, d) => S[0][d] + 0.5 * (v - S[0][d])); F[i] = f(S[i]); } }
    }
  }
  return S[0];
}

// Binom 2PL fit: minimize the link term, which is equivalent to minimizing total expected KL
fit2PL = {
  const n = K - 1, m = popGrid.map(fStar);
  const obj = q => { let s = 0; const aa = Math.exp(q[0]);
    for (let i = 0; i < popGrid.length; i++) s += popW[i] * n * bernKL(m[i], clamp(logistic(aa * (popGrid[i] - q[1])), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12));
    return s; };
  let iMid = 0; m.forEach((v, i) => { if (Math.abs(v - 0.5) < Math.abs(m[iMid] - 0.5)) iMid = i; });
  let q = nelderMead(obj, [0, popGrid[iMid]], 0.5, 600);
  q = nelderMead(obj, q, 0.05, 600);
  return { a2: Math.exp(q[0]), b2: q[1] };
}

function decompAt(th) {
  const n = K - 1, P = gpcmPr(th, a, thresholds), fs = fStar(th), f = f2PL(th);
  const structural = klVec(P, binomVec(n, fs)), link = n * bernKL(fs, f), total = klVec(P, binomVec(n, f));
  return { structural, link, total };
}

popDecomp = {
  let s = 0, l = 0, t = 0;
  popGrid.forEach((th, i) => { const d = decompAt(th); s += popW[i] * d.structural; l += popW[i] * d.link; t += popW[i] * d.total; });
  return { structural: s, link: l, total: t, share: 100 * s / t, idErr: Math.abs(t - (s + l)) };
}

gridData = thetaGrid.map(th => {
  const gp = gpcmPr(th, a, thresholds), n = K - 1;
  const mm = binomVec(n, fStar(th)), b2 = binomVec(n, f2PL(th));
  const d = decompAt(th);
  return { th, gp, mm, b2, erfG: meanOf(gp), erfMM: meanOf(mm), erfB2: meanOf(b2), ...d };
})

pointData = {
  const n = K - 1, gp = gpcmPr(theta, a, thresholds);
  const q = comp === "Binom 2PL" ? binomVec(n, f2PL(theta)) : binomVec(n, fStar(theta));
  const contrib = gp.map((p, k) => p > 0 ? p * (Math.log(p) - Math.log(Math.max(q[k], 1e-300))) : 0);
  return { gp, q, contrib, meanG: meanOf(gp), meanMM: (K - 1) * fStar(theta), meanB2: (K - 1) * f2PL(theta), d: decompAt(theta) };
}

CRF_COLORS = ["#185FA5","#1D9E75","#BA7517","#C53A35","#7F77DD","#5DCAA5","#E24B4A"]
CRF_DASH   = [null,[4,3],[2,3],[4,2,2,2],[6,2],[3,3],[5,2]]
COMP_COLOR = "#C53A35"
B2_COLOR = "#2A7FB8"

erfPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: 340, height: 200, marginLeft: 45,
  x: {label: "θ", tickValues: [-2,-1,0,1,2]},
  y: {label: "E[X | θ]", domain: [0, K - 1]},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX([theta], {stroke: "#888", strokeDasharray: "3,2", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
    Plot.line(gridData, {x: "th", y: "erfG", stroke: "#333", strokeWidth: 2.5}),
    Plot.line(gridData, {x: "th", y: "erfMM", stroke: COMP_COLOR, strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "5,3"}),
    Plot.line(gridData, {x: "th", y: "erfB2", stroke: B2_COLOR, strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "2,2"})
  ]
})

crfPlot = {
  const key = comp === "Binom 2PL" ? "b2" : "mm";
  const marks = [Plot.ruleX([theta], {stroke:"#888", strokeDasharray:"3,2", strokeWidth:1.2})];
  for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
    marks.push(Plot.line(gridData, {x:"th", y: d => d.gp[k],
      stroke: CRF_COLORS[k % CRF_COLORS.length], strokeWidth: 1.8}));
    marks.push(Plot.line(gridData, {x:"th", y: d => d[key][k],
      stroke: CRF_COLORS[k % CRF_COLORS.length], strokeWidth: 1.5,
      strokeDasharray: (CRF_DASH[k % CRF_DASH.length] ?? [4,3]).join(",")}));
  }
  return Plot.plot({width:340, height:210, marginLeft:45,
    x:{label:"θ", tickValues:[-2,-1,0,1,2]},
    y:{label:"P(X = k | θ)", domain:[0,1]}, marks});
}

probPlot = {
  const rows = Array.from({length: K}, (_, k) => k).flatMap(k => [
    {k: String(k), prob: pointData.gp[k], model: "GPCM"},
    {k: String(k), prob: pointData.q[k], model: comp}
  ]);
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 300, height: 230, marginLeft: 45,
    fx: {label: "k", tickFormat: d => d},
    x: {axis: null, domain: ["GPCM", comp]},
    y: {label: "P(X = k | θ)"},
    color: {domain: ["GPCM", comp], range: ["#444", comp === "Binom 2PL" ? B2_COLOR : COMP_COLOR], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(rows, {x: "model", y: "prob", fill: "model", fx: "k"}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
}

contribPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: 300, height: 230, marginLeft: 50,
  x: {label: "k", domain: Array.from({length:K}, (_,k) => String(k))},
  y: {label: "P_GPCM(k) · log{P_GPCM(k) / P_bin(k)}"},
  color: {domain:["adds to KL","offsets KL"], range:["#9E2A2A","#185FA5"], legend:true},
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(
      Array.from({length:K}, (_,k) => ({ k: String(k), c: pointData.contrib[k], sign: pointData.contrib[k] >= 0 ? "adds to KL" : "offsets KL" })),
      {x:"k", y:"c", fill:"sign", insetLeft:2, insetRight:2}
    ),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})

klPlot = {
  const rows = gridData.flatMap(d => [
    {th: d.th, v: d.structural, part: "Structural"},
    {th: d.th, v: d.link, part: "Link"}
  ]);
  return Plot.plot({
    width: 340, height: 220, marginLeft: 50,
    x: {label: "θ", tickValues: [-2,-1,0,1,2]},
    y: {label: "KL(GPCM ‖ Binom 2PL), nats", grid: true},
    color: {domain: ["Structural", "Link"], range: [COMP_COLOR, B2_COLOR], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.areaY(rows, {x: "th", y: "v", fill: "part", fillOpacity: 0.55}),
      Plot.line(gridData, {x: "th", y: "total", stroke: "#333", strokeWidth: 1.5}),
      Plot.ruleX([theta], {stroke: "#888", strokeDasharray: "3,2", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
fmt = v => v.toFixed(3)
html`<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:24px; align-items:start;">
  <div>
    <p style="font-size:0.8em;font-weight:500;color:#555;margin:0 0 4px;">Expected response functions</p>
    ${erfPlot}
    <p style="font-size:0.75em;color:#777;margin:2px 0 0;">Solid = GPCM · <span style="color:${COMP_COLOR}">dashed = mean-matched binomial</span> (identical by construction) · <span style="color:${B2_COLOR}">dotted = Binom 2PL</span></p>
    <p style="font-size:0.8em;font-weight:500;color:#555;margin:16px 0 4px;">Category response functions</p>
    ${crfPlot}
    <p style="font-size:0.75em;color:#777;margin:4px 0 0;">Solid = GPCM &nbsp;·&nbsp; Dashed = ${comp} &nbsp;·&nbsp; Colours index k</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <p style="font-size:0.8em;font-weight:500;color:#555;margin:0 0 4px;">P(X = k | θ = ${theta.toFixed(2)})</p>
    ${probPlot}
    <table style="font-size:0.78em;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:8px;width:100%">
      <tr><td style="padding:2px 8px 2px 0;color:#555;">E[X|θ] GPCM</td>
          <td style="padding:2px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;">${pointData.meanG.toFixed(3)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:2px 8px 2px 0;color:#555;">E[X|θ] mean-matched binomial</td>
          <td style="padding:2px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;">${pointData.meanMM.toFixed(3)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:2px 8px 2px 0;color:#555;">E[X|θ] Binom 2PL</td>
          <td style="padding:2px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;">${pointData.meanB2.toFixed(3)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:2px 8px 2px 0;color:#555;">GPCM thresholds</td>
          <td style="padding:2px 0;">${thresholds.map(b => b.toFixed(2)).join(", ")}</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:2px 8px 2px 0;color:#555;">Binom 2PL a′, b′</td>
          <td style="padding:2px 0;">${fit2PL.a2.toFixed(2)}, ${fit2PL.b2.toFixed(2)}</td></tr>
    </table>
  </div>
  <div>
    <p style="font-size:0.8em;font-weight:500;color:#555;margin:0 0 4px;">Per-category contribution to KL(GPCM ‖ ${comp}) at θ = ${theta.toFixed(2)}</p>
    ${contribPlot}
    <p style="font-size:0.75em;color:#777;margin:4px 0 0;">Bars sum to the KL divergence at this θ (${fmt(pointData.contrib.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0))} nats). A negative bar is a category the binomial over-predicts; it lowers the sum but cannot make it negative.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:24px; align-items:start; margin-top:28px;">
  <div>
    <p style="font-size:0.8em;font-weight:500;color:#555;margin:0 0 4px;">Decomposition of the Binom 2PL's KL divergence across θ</p>
    ${klPlot}
    <p style="font-size:0.75em;color:#777;margin:4px 0 0;">Stacked: structural (loss of the mean-matched binomial) + link ((K−1)·KL between Bernoulli(f*) and Bernoulli(f)). Black line = total KL(GPCM ‖ Binom 2PL); it equals the sum exactly.</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <p style="font-size:0.8em;font-weight:500;color:#555;margin:0 0 4px;">Decomposition, nats per response</p>
    <table style="font-size:0.82em;border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">
      <tr style="color:#888;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd"><td style="padding:3px 8px 3px 0"></td><td style="padding:3px 8px;text-align:right">at θ = ${theta.toFixed(2)}</td><td style="padding:3px 0;text-align:right">avg over θ ~ N(0,1)</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:3px 8px 3px 0;color:${COMP_COLOR}">Structural</td><td style="padding:3px 8px;text-align:right">${fmt(pointData.d.structural)}</td><td style="text-align:right">${fmt(popDecomp.structural)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:3px 8px 3px 0;color:${B2_COLOR}">Link</td><td style="padding:3px 8px;text-align:right">${fmt(pointData.d.link)}</td><td style="text-align:right">${fmt(popDecomp.link)}</td></tr>
      <tr style="border-top:1px solid #ddd"><td style="padding:3px 8px 3px 0">Total (Binom 2PL)</td><td style="padding:3px 8px;text-align:right">${fmt(pointData.d.total)}</td><td style="text-align:right">${fmt(popDecomp.total)}</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="padding:3px 8px 3px 0;font-weight:600">Structural share</td><td style="padding:3px 8px;text-align:right">${(100 * pointData.d.structural / pointData.d.total).toFixed(1)}%</td><td style="text-align:right;font-weight:600">${popDecomp.share.toFixed(1)}%</td></tr>
    </table>
    <p style="font-size:0.75em;color:#777;margin:8px 0 0;">The structural share is the part of the binomial's loss that a better link function could not remove. In the manuscript's simulation conditions it averages 86–96% under the GPCM DGP; those figures average over items with random discrimination, location shifts, and threshold noise, so a single item here will not match them exactly. Identity check |total − (structural + link)| = ${popDecomp.idErr.toExponential(1)}.</p>
  </div>
</div>`
```
